instructor: She rarely uses e-mails to announce news about the class, even not announcing important news and developments. In order to engage participation in the class, she asks questions to the students in the zoom class. However, this is done in a very repeated and not motivating way, most people feel anxious and scared about this which leads to low attendance rates. People start not participating in the course to not get asked questions. She can be harsh against the students when certain things are not going the way she wants to be, which also decreases the overall motivation of the students. There are way too many pop quizzes happening in this course, in most classes students usually find themselves having a random pop quiz just after finishing a topic. Students who did not have the time to review the topic find themselves unable to give a proper answer during the quiz. Usually, only a few people get a correct answer however the quizzes keep happening. In some cases, the lecture continues even after a quiz, almost resetting any kind of focus or motivation a students has during the lecture. This behavior also leads to decreased attendance rates. The lecture notes are not near sufficient, a huge portion of the lectures notes are simply pages from the book used in the course, which are also what the whole lecture is studied over, the number of original content in the course is really, really low. Students don't really need a slide containing the content of the book while they can simply read that chapter itself. Because the lecture is taught over a single specific book, it makes people lose interest in the course extremely quickly. The book should be used as a reference point and should not be in the core center of the course. The given quizzes and examples are not explained well enough which usually makes students think about scenarios where they don't have the necessary information for a situation. The codes are basically written in word documents with almost no readability
